text:
maria: Hey team — trying to port the lightweight Next starter from LlamaIndex -> LangChain v0.5. Two problems so far: auth token refresh intermittently fails on edge runtime, and streaming responses hang when wrapped by our retry middleware. Anyone run into this?

sam: what error do you see for the token refresh?

maria: 401 after refresh attempt. stack points to sdk/auth.ts where refresh is fired but the fetch that follows sometimes runs before token is applied. snippet:```js
// auth.ts
await client.auth.refreshToken();
await fetch('/api/generate', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${client.token}` } });
```

arjun: LangChain v0.5 changed the prompt/memory call patterns. We had an adapter that assumed memory.saveContext returned a Promise; it's sync now in some adapters — can introduce race if code awaited wrong thing.

lee: for the streaming hang, we traced it to our retry wrapper trying to re-read the ReadableStream on retries. Edge runtime (Vercel/Workers) doesn't support stream teeing so the second attempt just blocks.

maria: buffering a small prefix helps but adds ~30-60ms. Not great for low-latency demos. Is there a recommended SDK parity helper to clone/tee streams safely?

sam: not in stable yet. We discussed a `streamUtils.cloneStream` in last sprint. Filed RFC: GH #1429 to add a fallback that buffers up to N bytes then switches to replay.

devbot: RFC #1429 created by sam — "stream utils: clone/readable fallback for edge" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1429

maria: one more: Vercel Edge build fails with `TextEncoder` polyfill when importing the LlamaIndex shim. Workaround was to lazy-import client-only modules inside useEffect or dynamic import with { ssr: false }.

arjun: can you paste a minimal repro or the failing build log? If it's tiny we can add it to the samplekits test matrix and block regressions.

maria: will upload a tiny repro gist in ~30m. For now I'll add a short note in the starter README about LangChain v0.5 and an example patch to the adapter. :memo:

lee: good call. I can add a CI job that builds the Next starter against langchain@latest/nightly and reports failures on PRs — prevents surprises for new PRs.

maria: that'd be awesome, thanks! I'll ping you the repro link. :pray:

sam: moving this to a follow-up ticket to allocate dev time — we should aim to ship the stream utils in the next SDK patch and update samplekits.

maria: cheers, thanks everyone — I'll drop the gist and link the RFC in the PR.
